name: dsh-shaders
description: Shaders: seven `shader_*` tools that compile GLSL for real in a disposable headless browser and name the rung they reached - fragment/vertex sources in ES 1.00, ES 3.00, Shadertoy and desktop dialects, a corpus of 106 Radiant shaders and 56 shader-skills GLSL files, emit for web/.frag/ISF/FFGL/Shadertoy, a Shaders tab with live WebGL preview, and five skills whose every example a check compiles.

scripts.vendor:check: node vendor/radiant/build.mjs --check && node vendor/shader-skills/build.mjs --check && node vendor/glsl-links/build.mjs --check
